construct.diagnosis_or_process: Patient-engaged warm handoff during an in-practice care transition
construct.mechanism: A warm handoff transfers care face to face between health professionals in front of the patient, treating the patient as a team member who can hear, clarify, correct, and ask questions. This provides a safety check against omissions or distortions during transitions.
construct.primary_system: Social Sciences: Communication and Interpersonal Skills

second_answer_attack.strongest_alternative: Send an asynchronous electronic handoff to the pharmacist.
second_answer_attack.resolution: An electronic message can transmit data, but a warm handoff specifically uses direct team-to-team communication with the patient present so the patient can hear, correct, clarify, and ask questions.
